facts.text: I am thinking of building a new fence for my backyard to expand the area for my animals to roam around.
I have two Nigerian Dwarf goats.
I got the two Nigerian Dwarf goats about three weeks ago.
I am considering high-tensile wire fencing as an option.
I need recommendations for fencing pliers and wire cutters that can handle high-tensile wire.
I am wondering about the best way to stretch and tighten high-tensile wire fencing.
I am wondering about the best way to attach the wire to the fence posts.
I have been thinking about adding shade structures for my goats and chickens.

keyphrases: fencing materials for goats and chickens
shade structure for goats and chickens
